# K-DART: Korean corporate disclosure data (OpenAPI)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a Korean-language skill for Korea's DART (Financial Supervisory Service electronic disclosure system) OpenAPI: search filings, company profiles, financial statements and major-event reports, with hard rules (never execute payments, never handle plaintext credentials, never bypass legal/identity boundaries). The skill is a CLI stub: full instructions are delivered by running `npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 instruct k-dart` (prints only the instructions applicable to your runtime), helper files are listed via `files`, updates via `update`. Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Korean**; requires your own free DART OpenAPI key (`API_K_DART` env var) and Node.js 18+; the npx package runs third-party code from npm — review the package before first run (the safety check in the install prompt applies to it too); MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
